panels.title: Times each agent was called (time range)
panels.description: Row 51: BYO agents from ewallet_agent_invocations_total; declarative agents from their invoke_agent span metric (cumulative since the collector started). Exact count from zero-initialized per-pod series: max_over_time - min_over_time per series, summed; no extrapolation. Limits: a process restart inside the same pod resets a series under the same identity and is under-counted; events after the last scrape in the range, or between the range start and the first sample of a series that predates the range, are not visible (one 30 s scrape interval); series that first appeared already incremented (images before F2) are not counted.
